hypothesis_result.interpretation: A fixed-view hold after the first 1-degree increment restored a large VINS feature count, but health failed during the second increment at about 1.55 degrees truth yaw. The one-degree interval is still too coarse to preserve health across the observed failure point; intermittent feature counts alone did not keep localization and mapping ready.

motion_truth.qualification: Debug-only sensor-fixture truth; not used by mapping. Truth yaw exceeded the 8-degree commanded total by about 0.82 degrees.

input_capture.qualification: The raw header/status recorder covered its requested window. Sampled forwarded depth and exact camera pose stopped at sim 18.745 seconds near the first health lock; the input capture is not a full raw-image recording.

snapshots.runner_exit_code: not captured after the host session handle was lost

next_experiment.primary_variable: Maximum uninterrupted yaw increment reduced from 1 degree to 0.25 degree. Angular acceleration, 5.164-second fixed-view hold, location and surround stay fixed.
next_experiment.hypothesis: More frequent fixed-view reacquisition before the 1.55-degree truth-yaw failure point will keep localization valid through a 2-degree pilot and keep map input ready.
next_experiment.success_criterion: Localization remains valid through achieved truth yaw at least 2.0 degrees, MapStatus remains input_ready with the same epoch/map identity and fresh depth, and a matched snapshot can be captured. Pilot success does not mean full-turn coverage or N06 pass.

status: N06 and S4 remain in_progress; next_goal remains N06; no N06 exit criterion changed.
stop_reason: The 1-degree pilot recovered features during its first hold but localization failed during the second step. Continue N06 in Goal completion mode with a bounded 0.25-degree reacquisition pilot.
